Our people.

Leadership team

Chairman

Andrew Robb AO

Former Australian Federal Minister for Trade and Investment, with experience in major free trade agreements and international investment. Andrew brings a strategic perspective across energy, infrastructure and investment projects.

Director

Jason O’Hara

Jason brings a 38-year construction career spanning major stadium, retail, high-rise and mixed-use developments. His experience combines end-to-end project leadership with commercial and domestic building expertise.

Director

Joe Brinzi

Joe has 36 years of experience coordinating residential and commercial projects. His background includes workplace health and safety leadership and Victorian bushfire recovery work following the 2019 bushfires.

Director

Steve Wang

A former executive director at a global Fortune 500 listed property development company, Steve has overseen real estate development portfolios across the United States, United Kingdom and Australia.

Director · BOW Structures

Hassan Kassem

Hassan brings more than 25 years of residential, commercial and mixed-use construction experience. His focus includes early contractor involvement, structural optimisation, safe delivery and practical client outcomes.

Estimating Director · Queensland

Nidhi Pandey

With a background in architecture and construction management, Nidhi provides quantity surveying and estimating expertise, supported by strong communication, problem-solving and teamwork.

Technical specialists

Principal Engineer

Bryce Kemp

Founder and Director of KPA Consulting, Bryce brings 17 years of experience across more than 900 projects, including major infrastructure work on the Melbourne Metro Tunnel and West Gate Tunnel.

Post-Tensioning Specialist

Mahitha Cherukuvada

Mahitha brings more than 17 years of experience in post-tensioning and structural remediation, including project lifecycle management, team leadership and value engineering.
